summary: M3.S1 ImmobilCloud B2C Public Portal — full end-to-end testing PASSED. Backend: 13/13 pytest pass on /app/backend/tests/test_immobilcloud_public.py (~2s). All 4 public no-auth endpoints verified: GET /api/cloud/search (returns items+total+pagination, agency.name populated, filters by city prefix-match case-insensitive, by operation=sale/rent, invalid sort=xxx → 422, page/page_size honored); GET /api/cloud/facets (returns total_active+cities[]+property_types[], operation=rent filter works); GET /api/cloud/property/{pid} (returns detail; sensitive fields owner/seller_client_id/commission_pct/listing_agent_id correctly excluded via PUBLIC_FIELDS projection, photos transformed to {url,is_cover,caption}, agency card attached, view counter incremented best-effort); GET /api/cloud/agency/{slug} (404 for unknown). Endpoints fully public — verified by clean Session() with no cookies/headers. Curl confirmed live data: 1 active property (Test OMNIA Agency, Roma, appartamento, sale, €250,000, 80m², 3 rooms). Regression: 41/42 pass (1 expected skip) on themes+clients_smart+csv_import+custom_domain — no breakage from is_listed_on_immobilcloud field addition (the {$ne: false} filter correctly includes legacy docs without the field). Frontend /it/cloud loaded successfully: hero h1 'Trova la casa dei tuoi sogni' rendered in Fraunces serif font (computed fontFamily: 'Fraunces, Georgia, serif') ✅, cream B2C bg #fbf9f5 (rgb(251,249,245)) confirmed visually distinct from B2B stone palette ✅, op-sale/op-rent toggle works (default sale active, op-rent click refetches facets+featured), cloud-search-city + cloud-search-btn submit navigates to /it/cloud/search?operation=sale&city=Roma, cloud-total displays '1 immobili attivi in tutta Italia', cloud-cities-row + cloud-featured both visible with data. SearchPage: all 9 required data-testids present (filter-city, filter-type, filter-price-min, filter-price-max, filter-surface-min, filter-rooms-min, filter-sort, results-count, search-results-list), 1 property card cloud-card-{id} rendered with price in Fraunces serif (€250.000) + navy color (#0B1E3F), title, city, surface, rooms, agency badge. Filter mutation (rooms_min=2) refetches correctly. Empty state: filling filter-city='ZZZZZ-NoCity' surfaces search-empty as expected. CTA buttons use navy (#0B1E3F) instead of black — B2C palette correctly applied.

issues: Palette is restrained cream/navy — looks 'editorial' rather than overtly colorful. User explicitly asked for 'più colorato (no editorial-sobrio)'. Current scheme reads as a sober/refined B2C (better than B2B stone-only, but still understated). Consider adding amber/gold accent more prominently in CTAs/badges/hero, or warmer secondary tones, if the user wanted a livelier B2C feel akin to Idealista/Immobiliare.it.

action_items: (Optional, design feedback) Make B2C palette more vibrant: gold/amber accents on featured-card badges and primary CTA hover, warmer accent on op-toggle. User wording 'più colorato (no editorial-sobrio)' may not be fully satisfied by current cream/navy/gold scheme.
critical_code_review_comments: public_portal.py (~295 lines) — clean single-module, 4 endpoints, well under 700-line limit. PUBLIC_FIELDS and LIST_FIELDS projections correctly exclude internal fields (_id, owner, seller_client_id, commission_pct, listing_agent_id, lead_count, view_count) → privacy preserved.

_base_filter uses {is_listed_on_immobilcloud: {$ne: False}} which correctly opt-IN by default for legacy docs (field absent → matches) AND respects explicit opt-out (field=false → excluded). Matches the (b3) user choice 'opt-out default'.
Price filter logic switches between price (sale) and rent_monthly (rent) based on operation param — correct B2C UX.
view_count increment wrapped in try/except — best-effort fire-and-forget, won't fail user request. Good.
Sort enum validated via Pydantic regex pattern (^(recent|price_asc|price_desc|surface_desc)$) → returns 422 on invalid value (confirmed by test).
Endpoints mounted via router.include_router(public_portal_router) with no auth dependency → fully public as designed. Verified with clean Session().

Cover URL helper _cover_photo has a minor inconsistency: returns f'/api/public/property/<empty>/photo/{idx}' if property_id missing, then strips '//photo/' → could yield odd URL. Cosmetic only; _to_card uses different (correct) logic. Consider removing dead helper or fixing.

ImmocloudApp.jsx (~445 lines) — single file, well-organized into HomePage/SearchPage/PropertyCard/FilterBlock/SegSelect/FooterB2C. Good separation; could extract PropertyCard to its own file if it grows. Currently fine.
Frontend fetch() does NOT include credentials → correct for public endpoints (CORS allows credentials only when needed).
Hero h1 uses Fraunces serif via inline style — works but consider Tailwind class once font is registered globally.

B2C palette correctly uses #0B1E3F navy + #C19A6B gold + #fbf9f5 cream instead of B2B stone-only → palette differentiation achieved. However the overall look still reads 'refined editorial' rather than 'colorful B2C portal' — depends on user expectation.
Dev-env console warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' originates from Emergent's x-dynamic instrumentation wrapping mapped {n} children inside <option> — NOT user code, ignorable in prod.
Map (OpenStreetMap+Leaflet) deferred to M3.S3 as documented — not in current scope.
